AC-0064 — Health hearts render as real heart graphics

Status: DONE. The 10 heart Labels (Unicode ♥ → Godot default font → tofu squares) were replaced by a single HeartRow Control that draws a code-generated 9×9 pixel-art MC heart (NEAREST) in three states, driven by the same v = p.hp − i·2 model as before. No hp logic, food bar, or hotbar was touched.

BEFORE — tasks/AC-0033/p2_paused.png, row above hotbar: 10 filled squares (tofu)
AFTER rows — top→bottom: BEFORE (squares) · hp=20 (10 full red) · hp=13 (6 full + 1 two-tone half + 3 gray silhouettes) · hp=1 (1 half + 9 empty) · hp=0.5 (1 half + 9 empty). Note the visible dark outline + taper (lobes→point), and the half heart splits bright-red (left) / dark (right).

Code change

  • godot/ui/inventory.gd: new inner class HeartRow extends Control (9×9 bitmask → 3 ImageTextures: full / two-tone half / empty silhouette, CanvasItem NEAREST; _draw paints 10 cells, 18px, 3px gap). _hearts: Array (10 Labels) → _heart_row: HeartRow. Positioning keeps the old contract: centered row at vs.y − 64 − cell. Visibility when p == null kept. Damage-flash hook (_on_damaged/_flash) untouched. State thresholds per spec: full v≥2… (per-2hp) / half 0<v<2 / empty v≤0, i.e. v = hp − i·2 exactly as the old label code.
  • godot/scenes/main.gd: tiny env-gated harness hook AWECRAFT_HP (added to HARNESS_ENVS; sets player.hp right before the snapshot). Kept for future HUD shots.

  • Shape is NOT square — per-row fill widths of heart 1 (hearts_full): [0,0,8,8,16,16,18,18,18,18,18,18,14,14,14,14,10,10,6,6,0,0] → top (8) < middle (18), tapering to the bottom point. Before was a flat filled square.
  • Red hue present: sampled heart pixels = rgb(229,37,33) (MC red, r≫g,b); outline rgb(64,14,16); empty silhouette rgb(96,80,80).
  • Half = two distinct tones across its width: left column red 64px vs right column gray 136px (MC left/red, right/dark).

Deviations / notes

  • Row is slightly wider than the old label run (10×18 + 9×3 = 207px vs ~153–172px for the tiny □) — still the same centered row at the same vertical offset; size spec was "~14-18px", using 18px. Positioning math unchanged.
  • Kept the env-gated AWECRAFT_HP hook in main.gd (documented above) for future HUD shots.
  • Web world-detection in the capture helper logged world seen=False (its green-count probe sampled only the sky band), but the HUD shot was still captured and verified (1480 red heart px in frame); the hearts were visually confirmed in the crop and full frame.
  • Faithful 32x pack's forge/neoforge icons.png was checked — it contains a red X and a red cursor, no heart tile, so the glyph is code-drawn (as anticipated).
